remarks: Enjoy a convenient lifestyle at this centrally located well maintained Custom Colonial with a gorgeous pool, expansive covered patio, fabulous yard in the heart of Westport. Featuring an open spacious floor plan, gourmet kitchen with large center island leading to the dining room, family room with a dramatic two-sided floor to ceiling stone fireplace. Walls of glass open to the stone patio overlooking a private, fenced acre, in-ground pool, green house/barn. The 2nd floor includes a large primary suite plus 3 generously sized bedrooms all en-suite. Minutes to all town amenities, train, shopping, beaches, schools. Rental options include summer and short term (different pricing, min 3 months)
